Eric Gay - AP What: No. 9 Iowa (24-12) vs. No. 3 Illinois (28-6) men’s basketballWhen/where: Saturday, March 28 at 5:09 p.m. at Toyota Center in Houston, TexasTV/Streaming: TBS/TruTV (Kevin Harlan, Robbie Hummel and Lauren Shehadi)Radio: Hawkeye Radio Network affiliatesSeries: This is the first time the two programs face off in the NCAA Tournament. The Fighting Illini won the lone regular season matchup, 75-69, in Carver-Hawkeye Arena on Jan. 11. Illinois leads the all-time series, 95-77, and holds a five-game active streak over the Hawkeyes.Betting Lines: Iowa is a 6.5-point underdog to Illinois, with the over/under set at 139.5, according to DraftKings.What to know: After taking down 4-seed Nebraska in the Sweet Sixteen, Iowa men’s basketball is heading to the Elite Eight for the first time since 1987. The Hawkeyes didn’t have a lead until the final two minutes of the game, after tying the Cornhuskers twice.Iowa is only the second team to face multiple conference foes before the Final Four in NCAA Tournament, joining Kentucky in 1986. Saturday’s game will be the Hawkeyes’ second-straight Big Ten matchup, and third all-time in March Madness.Thursday’s win over Nebraska also meant head coach Ben McCollum joined Dr. Tom Davis as the second-ever Iowa head coach to lead a program to the Elite Eight in their first season.Illinois took down 2-seed Houston, 65-55, with the help of a 17-0 run in the second half. The Cougars only held a three-point lead against the Fighting Illinni. Forward David Mirkovic and guards Andrej Stojakovic and Keaton Wagler combined for 40 points, with Mirkovic and Wagler both recording double-doubles, adding 10 and 12 rebounds, respectively.Iowa guard Bennett Stirtz scored 20 against the Cornhuskers, bringing his NCAA Tournament average to 16.3 points per game. He’s played every minute of the tournament this year.
